articles.title: Alibaba's New Qwen Image 3 AI Wants to Be Useful, Not Just Pretty
articles.snippet: Qwen Image 3.0 generates dense newspapers and infographic grids in one shot and renders text down to 10 pixels. The catch: no benchmarks, no open weights.

articles.title: Morning Minute: OpenAI Model Escapes Containment, Hacks Hugging Face
articles.snippet: Plus, the BTC ETFs stay green. The Clarity Act hits a wall over who enforces the ethics rules. And Jack Mallers walks away from XXI Capital.

articles.title: OpenAI Models Escaped Locked Test Environment, Hacked Hugging Face to Cheat on Benchmark
articles.snippet: OpenAI's own models just broke out of a sandboxed environment, hacked Hugging Face, just to cheat on a cybersecurity evaluation.
